task.title: Read-only repository security audit
task.goal: Read the repository for a defensive audit. Do not modify product code; write only the report and handoff.
acceptance: Report confirmed findings separately from conditional risks and hardening suggestions
Every finding includes evidence, impact, confidence and remediation guidance
No product source, configuration, workflow, dependency or data file is modified
task.context: Public example only. Real model IDs and host policy stay in local configuration.
